purpose: One revised retrospective independent-exposure test after the first COSMOGRAIL undercoverage result; old outcomes remain development data and are never reclassified as unused.
target_catalogue: CDS J/A+A/703/A250, independent LCO CTIO 1m R observations, Sorgenfrei et al. 2025, doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202555933
development: All 1002 consumed Millon2020 epochs plus 25 independent LCO R epochs before 2019; original first test is explicitly consumed. HST images may select the revised physical source.

primary.allowed_driver: All 54 later C magnitudes, batch conditioning only
primary.driver_choice: C was selected because its consumed first-experiment behavior was substantially better calibrated than A/B. No new numerical LCO target values informed this choice.

secondary: All 216 later magnitudes without later driver; overlaps primary, not an independent replication.
V_release: All 80 epochs remain unparsed, unscored and available for a later explicitly new protocol.
blinding_limit: Catalogue acquisition parsed timestamps only. Published abstract/methods revealed qualitative microlensing findings during source identification; this is not complete analyst blinding. No numerical confirmatory photometry, plots, model predictions or scores were inspected before freezing.
reduction_limit: Independent exposure photons and later dates, but retrospective common DIA reduction with reference image mostly from 2022. Exact reference exposure list unavailable. Shared reference/zero-point uncertainty may correlate calibration and targets; this is not independent blinded reduction or prospective prediction.
clock_map: Marginalize old COSMOGRAIL offsets [-.5,0,+.5]day with development-only weights. LCO native MJD retained, undeclared subday time-scale/heliocentric convention remains a limitation.
brightness_model: The separate he0435_revision_development_20261020.json specifies the classical OU+Brownian+random-slope model, development rolling folds and proper normalized diagonal predictive calibration. Retain all finite nuisance components and their development-only clock weights. No BHSM quantum-state or Wick meaning.

macro_revision.body: Positive outer Plummer plus compact Plummer, common total enclosed mass for original nonlinear R1 scalar equation
macro_revision.purpose: Regular unresolved matter surrogate; no SMBH inference from this parameterization
macro_revision.fitting: Original 9 optical nuisance parameters and bounds, original astrometry plus exact development brightness likelihood at MAP variability hyperparameters; declared two-stage conditional empirical Bayes.
macro_revision.selection: Fit the five conventional candidates on development only; select minimum development objective among candidates satisfying the conservative HST F814W nonnegative-pixel bound for the sum of every extra-image PSF template. Report all candidates. If none satisfies it, retain best development candidate and explicitly report failure, with no target-driven profile change.
macro_revision.paired_R1: Use selected compact mass and scale for both families; nuisance-refit R1 using the same development data; also report fixed-body activation. Compute scalar from total density/enclosed mass rather than adding nonlinear scalar solutions.
macro_revision.HST_condition: Macro flux comparison assumes no differential extinction/microlensing. Test original prediction before revision. Include all unresolved nuclear images; do not turn conditional HST tension into unconditional mass-profile exclusion.
macro_revision.nuisance_mixture: For a fixed macro delay vector, transport retained empirical nuisance draws by replacing delays and reweighting each using exp(LL_dev(new delays)-LL_dev(empirical delays)). This finite conditional approximation is not a converged macro posterior or marginal evidence. No physical posterior integration is claimed.

fixed_body_control_amendment_before_targ: In addition to the prespecified separately refitted R1, score its fixed-conventional-body activation using the original source-derived delay offsets, with identical optical nuisance parameters. This separates small physical response from optimizer/nuisance drift; no target information is consumed.
matched_control: Positive source-derived effective conventional mass has identical retained optical metric; reuse score only after original source/projection check and label structural identity.
uncertainty: Finite correlated nuisance-draw mixture, development-frozen per-image affine scales with normalization Jacobian, driver-only posterior weight/state update. Short chains and fixed macro parameters limit interpretation; no future target offset, curve or hyperparameter fitting.
metrics: per-image and pooled 68.27/95 percent marginal coverage
mean predictive sigma and 95 percent interval width
95 percent interval score and marginal log density
interpretation: Report measured coverage and sharpness regardless of success. Correlated epochs do not justify independent-binomial significance. Conditional score differences are not Bayes factors or uniquely BHSM detections.
lock: Freeze data/source/model hashes and exact predictive artifact, commit freeze before any target parse; persistent exclusive-create exposure marker prevents silent retuning or second independent score. All HST and profile selection precedes exposure.
remaining_physical_domain: Remote quadratic screen remains conditional optical boundary, not derived global scalar environment. Local nonlinear environmental Hessian and microscopic preparation/statistical-state closures are not supplied by the empirical brightness model.
